label: The actual identity giver realizes a pure item above the receiving nature's capacity
paraphrase: Open analyst premise. For each distinct actual recipient whose esse is caused by an actual bearer with represented essence equal to its esse, that very giver realizes a pure item of the same inventory at a level strictly above the capacity assigned to this recipient's essence. The item may vary by recipient. Independent evidence must identify its positive content in the giver and justify its place on the selected common scale.
